messages:
sara: FYI bringing up thimble-2 on staging with per-channel int4 + dynamic microbatching. initial perf looks good but recall@5 dipped on our wiki-small holdout after I tuned batch params.
ajay: how big is the drop? which config did you change?
sara: baseline fp16 recall@5 = 0.845. int4 straight quant = 0.839. after increasing batch to 256 / microbatch 32 to improve throughput it fell to 0.792.
lucy: thats a big gap. did tokenization or pooling change?
sara: only change was max_seq 512->384 and enabled asymmetric pooling for perf. no whitening or L2 changes.
matt: can you paste the exact eval cmd/args so I can run locally?
sara: eval snippet:
```bash
python eval.py --model thimble-2 --quant=int4 --per_channel --batch_size=256 --microbatch=32 --max_seq=384 --dataset=wiki-small
```
ajay: try batch_size=128 + microbatch=16; if KV alignment is off large microbatches can shift cached prefixes. also check per-dim scales after quantization.
sara: kicking off 128/16 run now.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: staging/thimble-2/int4 by sara at 2026-03-23T12:35:02Z
lucy: also run a kmeans sanity (k=40) and report silhouette + centroid norm shifts. we had centroid collapse on a previous quant set.
sara: quick kmeans (k=40): fp16 silhouette=0.43, int4(256/32)=0.34, int4(128/16)=0.411. centroid mean norm: fp16=1.02, int4(256/32)=0.78, int4(128/16)=0.98.
matt: centroid norm drop looks suspicious. can you surface a few NN pairs where int4 misranked? want concrete examples (query vs top1/top5).
sara: pasted 4 examples: 1) "semantic parsing" - fp16 top1=paper on seq2seq semantics, int4 top1=blog overview (less precise). 2) "kubernetes pv reclaim policy" - fp16 exact ref, int4 returned general pv tutorial. 3) "bert fine-tuning" - int4 bumped another domain. 4) rare-token query "zarr chunking" had embedding norm ~0.34 vs fp16 ~0.98.
ajay: sounds like per-dim scaling mismatch. quick mitigation: apply per-vector L2 re-normalization post-quant to restore magnitudes, then re-eval. also capture per-token norm histograms.
sara: re-ran with post-quant L2 renorm (scale vectors to fp16 median norm) - results: recall@5=0.828, silhouette=0.423, centroid mean norm=1.01. throughput penalty ~+4% p99.
lucy: nice recovery. please create a task to make L2 renorm part of the quant pipeline by default for per-channel int4 and add a unit/regression test: wiki-small recall@5 within 1.5% of fp16.
matt: I'll add a canary job in the dedicated pool and a per-release histogram check.
ajay: add logging to onboarding dashboard: pre/post quant norm histograms, centroid drift delta, and sample NN diffs for top N degraded queries.
sara: uploaded histograms and NN diffs to the onboarding dashboard and updated the model card notes (quant: requires post-quant L2 renorm).
ops-bot: scheduled canary rollout for thimble-2 int4 tomorrow 09:00 UTC unless new regressions reported :white_check_mark:
